name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Name shown by Homebridge and Apple Home. This plugin is intentionally limited to the SofaBaton X1S.

hubIp.title: X1S Hub IP Address
hubIp.description: Static IP address of the SofaBaton X1S hub. Recommended for the first versions.

hubId.title: Stable Hub ID
hubId.description: Optional stable identifier used for HomeKit UUIDs. Do not change it after pairing.

discovery.title: Enable Discovery
discovery.description: Automatically read the X1S activity catalog from the local hub when hubIp is configured.

localListenPort.title: Local Listen Port
localListenPort.description: TCP port Homebridge opens while asking the X1S hub to connect back.

manualActivities.title: Manual Activities
manualActivities.description: Optional fallback or override list. When discovery is enabled, activities are read automatically from the X1S hub; manual entries with the same id override discovered names.

keyCode.title: Activation Key Code
keyCode.description: Advanced: key code sent with the activity activation frame. Default 198 is the X1S POWER_ON command used to start an activity. Change only for protocol testing.

enableAllOff.title: Enable All Off
enableAllOff.description: Disabled by default until the all-off path is validated on a real X1S.

assumeX1S.title: Assume Hub Is X1S
assumeX1S.description: Development fallback only. Do not enable for other SofaBaton models.
